capabilities: render inline sparklines as SVG from code blocks
pull numeric values from frontmatter properties
style sparklines with color, width, dash, and line options
generate sparkline SVG strings via a standalone CLI tool
extras: Bases and Dataview data sources are planned but not yet supported; the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no way to show small inline data visualizations such as sparklines within text, tables, or other Markdown contexts.
summary: Renders inline sparkline charts as SVG from literal numbers or frontmatter properties, using inline code blocks in notes.
